description: Koko turns travel ideas into organized, mappable trips. Plan somewhere to go in chat, then save it straight to your Koko account: a ranked list of places, or a day-by-day itinerary with timed stops. Koko pins every place on a map, fills in ratings, opening hours and photos, and gives you a private link you can open and keep editing on the web or in the Koko app. Ask ChatGPT what you have saved, open a list to change it, or check when a new one is ready.
